content.text: What's the XYZ displacement of the green soda can to the red bull can? Positive X means right, positive Y represents farther, positive Z represents up. Give an answer in feet. Choices: A. [2, -2, 0]. B. [2, -1, 0]. C. [-1, 1, 0]. D. [1, -1, 0]. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
